card.name: Words that lead into 'embrace' or 'comprehend'
card.fires_on: Fires where the next word is likely to be a form of 'embrace' or 'comprehend', as in 'territories comprehended in' or 'All-Embracing'. It also fires on nearby words in descriptions of the extent or range of a territory or area.

modes.label: Inside embrace/comprehend words
modes.description: The start or middle of 'comprehended' or 'Embracing' words.
modes.example: formed but a very small part of the extensive territories<< compreh>>ended in the modern republic of Mexico.

modes.label: Nearby words in territory descriptions
modes.description: Commas, pronouns and nouns in passages about the extent or scope of a region, where an embrace/include verb could follow.
modes.example: dwindling, as it approached its south-eastern limits, to less than two.<< It>> covered, probably, less than sixteen thousand

card.writes: It promotes forms of embrace, comprehend and comprise, so the model predicts verbs of encompassing.
card.plain: It lights up where a text is about to say that something embraces, includes or comprehends a region or range.
